overview.text: 最 commonly means “most” or “extremely.” Its construction is disputed: a received explanation combines 冃 and 取 in a phrase about forcing one’s way and taking.

components.text: The received explanation pairs 冃 with 取; another analysis associates it with a hat at the highest part of the head. Its role is disputed.
The received explanation includes 取 in a phrase about taking; another analysis proposes a sound role, which remains disputed.
